scope: 573 aligned simulated Larimer County profiles; 382 detached profiles eligible for allocation
clock: UTC hour starts; observations become available at interval end

housing_ablation.model: RF with temperature plus static housing
housing_ablation.excluded: All annual consumption and outcome fields; LSTM retains history-only architecture

installation_decision.method: Freeze mean predicted demand by UTC hour of week from 28 days of selected-model validation forecasts before the decision, then apply that profile throughout evaluation
installation_decision.important_limit: Planning proxy derived from pre-decision model forecasts; not a direct multi-month LSTM/RF forecast or rolling placement policy

sensitivity: One assumption at a time; fixed-shape PV scaling with fixed PV-case cost; uniform emissions factors
computing: Local CPU execution; no cluster or multi-machine speedup claim

scaling.note: Fixed smaller training protocol for controlled size scaling; separate from final accuracy tuning
scaling.fit_timer: training only; validation data prepared but not scored inside fit timer
